pasheadskins.gui.title: Armor Stand Skins
pasheadskins.gui.tooltip.head_skin: Render this stand as the player from its helmet
pasheadskins.gui.tooltip.lock_skin: Keep the current skin and cape. Unlock to load the live look again. A different player head also unlocks it. Wait until the skin has loaded before locking.
pasheadskins.gui.tooltip.cape: Show this player's cape. Off unless you turn it on. An elytra hides the cape and uses the cape texture only while this is on.
pasheadskins.gui.tooltip.cape_source: Mojang uses only the vanilla cape. Essential uses only an Essential wardrobe cape. Both uses the Mojang cape when that player has one equipped, otherwise Essential.
